story.title: Lila Berani Bercerita
story.author: BacaYuk Studio
story.moralMessage: Keberanian tumbuh ketika kita mencoba dan menerima dukungan dari teman.
story.description: Lila si kelinci kecil belajar mengatasi rasa gugup saat mendapat giliran bercerita di depan kelas.

pages.title: Giliran Lila
pages.text: Bu Rani mengumumkan bahwa besok setiap murid akan bercerita di depan kelas. Telinga Lila langsung menunduk karena ia merasa gugup.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Lila, a small cream-colored rabbit wearing yellow overalls and a teal scarf, sits in a warm woodland classroom while her owl teacher announces story day, Lila's ears lowered with gentle nervousness, colorful books and leaf-shaped windows, soft colorful children's storybook illustration.

pages.title: Cerita di Dalam Tas
pages.text: Di rumah, Lila memilih cerita tentang benih kecil yang tumbuh menjadi bunga. Ia memasukkan gambar benih itu ke dalam tas merahnya.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Lila, the same cream-colored rabbit in yellow overalls and teal scarf, prepares a drawing of a tiny seed growing into a flower at her bedroom desk, placing it into her small red satchel, warm evening mood, soft colorful children's storybook illustration.

pages.title: Latihan Pertama
pages.text: Lila mencoba bercerita di depan cermin. Suaranya pelan sekali, tetapi ia berhasil menyelesaikan satu kalimat.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Lila, the same cream-colored rabbit with round brown eyes, yellow overalls, and teal scarf, practices speaking in front of a round bedroom mirror, holding her seed drawing with both paws, shy but determined expression, gentle morning light, soft colorful children's storybook illustration.

pages.title: Dukungan Momo
pages.text: Momo si tupai datang mendengarkan. “Aku suka ceritamu,” katanya. Lila pun mencoba lagi dengan suara sedikit lebih jelas.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Lila, unchanged in yellow overalls and teal scarf, tells her seed story to Momo, a small reddish-brown squirrel wearing a blue vest, inside Lila's cozy room, Momo smiles and listens attentively, encouraging mood, soft colorful children's storybook illustration.

pages.title: Pagi yang Mendebarkan
pages.text: Keesokan paginya, jantung Lila berdebar saat berjalan ke sekolah. Ia menyentuh syal hijaunya dan mengingat latihan bersama Momo.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Lila, the same cream-colored rabbit wearing yellow overalls and teal scarf and carrying a red satchel, walks along a sunny woodland path toward school, one paw touching her scarf, nervous but hopeful mood, soft colorful children's storybook illustration.

pages.title: Satu Tarikan Napas
pages.text: Ketika namanya dipanggil, Lila berdiri di depan kelas. Ia menarik napas pelan, melihat Momo tersenyum, lalu mengucapkan kalimat pertamanya.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Lila, unchanged with cream fur, round brown eyes, yellow overalls, and teal scarf, stands at the front of the woodland classroom holding her seed drawing, taking a calm breath as Momo smiles from his seat, supportive classmates, warm reassuring mood, soft colorful children's storybook illustration.

pages.title: Suara yang Tumbuh
pages.text: Setiap kalimat membuat suara Lila semakin mantap. Teman-temannya mengikuti kisah benih kecil itu sampai akhirnya tumbuh menjadi bunga yang cerah.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Lila, identical cream-colored rabbit in yellow overalls and teal scarf, speaks confidently beside her seed-to-flower drawing in the woodland classroom, classmates watching with delighted faces, an imaginative glowing flower motif behind her, joyful mood, soft colorful children's storybook illustration.

pages.title: Berani Mencoba
pages.text: Kelas bertepuk tangan ketika Lila selesai. Lila masih merasa sedikit gugup, tetapi kini ia tahu bahwa keberanian dimulai dari satu kali mencoba.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Lila, unchanged in her yellow overalls and teal scarf, smiles with relief at the front of the woodland classroom while Momo, the reddish-brown squirrel in a blue vest, and other classmates clap, seed drawing visible, warm celebratory mood, soft colorful children's storybook illustration.

quizQuestion.question: Apa yang membantu Lila berani bercerita?
quizQuestion.explanation: Lila menjadi lebih berani setelah berlatih dan mendapat dukungan dari Momo.

Berani: telinga tegak dan senyum kecil

characterBible.skinFurOrHair: Bulu cokelat kemerahan dengan dada krem

productionGuide.coverPrompt: Lila, a small cream-colored rabbit in yellow overalls and a teal scarf, stands outside a cozy woodland school holding a seed-to-flower drawing, Momo the reddish-brown squirrel in a blue vest cheering beside her, hopeful and warm emotional promise, soft colorful children's storybook cover illustration, no readable text.
continuityRules: Gunakan desain, pakaian, warna, dan proporsi character bible tanpa perubahan.
Tampilkan tas merah Lila hanya saat perjalanan ke atau dari sekolah.
Pertahankan kelas sebagai ruang kayu hangat dengan jendela berbentuk daun.
Jangan memasukkan teks terbaca ke dalam ilustrasi.
productionGuide.negativePrompt: photorealistic, horror, violence, weapons, injury, threatening expressions, dark oppressive lighting, readable text, watermark, logo, extra limbs, duplicate character, changed outfit, changed fur color, inconsistent proportions

checklist: Periksa kesesuaian kosakata dengan usia 6-8 tahun.
Pastikan karakter Lila dan Momo konsisten pada semua ilustrasi.
Pastikan tidak ada teks terbaca atau watermark pada gambar.
Tinjau glosarium dan kuis sebelum buku diterbitkan.
warnings: coverImage masih menggunakan placeholder dan harus diganti dengan hasil ilustrasi final.
